crew.overview: New Jersey car mechanic Stacie Andree and her police detective girlfriend Laurel Hester both battle to secure Hester's pension benefits after she was diagnosed with a terminal illness.
crew.title: Freeheld

crew.overview: When a 10-year-old boy goes missing, lead investigator Greg Harper struggles to balance the pressure of the investigation and troubles with his wife, Jackie. Facing a recent affair, great strain is put on the family that slowly gnaws away at Jackie's grip on reality. But after a malicious presence manifests itself in their home and puts their son, Connor, in mortal danger, the cold, hard truth about evil in the Harper household is finally uncovered.
crew.title: I See You

crew.original_title: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind
crew.overview: Against all the odds, a thirteen year old boy in Malawi invents an unconventional way to save his family and village from famine.
crew.title: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind

details.biography: Tom Harberd is a film producer who joined British film finance company Head Gear Films in 2013 as finance and chief operating manager. In addition to a distinction-level Film Business MBA, Tom holds an MA in Film Production and a 1st-class BA (hons) in English & Creative Writing from the University of East Anglia, Norwich, England, UK.
details.name: Tom Harberd
